## Checklist

- [ ] Builds without warnings (`dotnet build -c Release`) and tests pass (`dotnet test`)
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] All new source files carry the AGPL license header
- [ ] UI texts are localized (English **and** German resources)
- [ ] Security-relevant change? Threat considered, documented in `docs/` or an ADR
- [ ] Architecture decision? New ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] `WORKPLAN.md` task checkboxes updated
- [ ] New dependency? License checked and added to `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`
